title: Amazon Wishlist Item Weekly Days on List Trend
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=amazon:wishlist days_on_list=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_on_list) as avg_duration, max(days_on_list) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days on list for Amazon wishlist item events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_on_list on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days on list with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether Amazon wishlist item tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
